item.title: TurboQuant: A first-principles walkthrough
item.description:
📝 The inner product reaches its largest positive value when the two arrows point in the same direction. It becomes negative when the arrows point in opposite directions, with its most negative value when they point exactly opposite. An inner product against a shrunken reconstruction comes out smaller than the same inner product against the input.
🔗 Read more: https://arkaung.github.io/interactive-turboquant/
